scope: Supported template and visibility keys only. Physical geometry, page scale and page-number text remain reported omissions. No alignment API is added; source GP8 alignment records retain bytes and consumer values, while projected GP5 fields use exact pinned per-element defaults.
authority: After parsing, a changed PageSetup template or visibility bit overrides only its matching HeaderFooter field. Unchanged legacy fields leave rich edits authoritative. Programmatic non-nil HeaderFooter owns the values; otherwise PageSetup supplies legacy templates. Copyright edits split on the first LF, retain the remainder in field two, and report multiple-separator ambiguity. Original GP5 field boundaries remain separate before the compatibility strings are joined.
export_policy: These complete-source artifacts use strict export with explicit allowances for pre-existing unrelated source-version, lyrics, RSE, writer, track-display and empty-beat reports, plus physical page limits and the tested ambiguous copyright split. Exact returned entries are recorded for each artifact. Focused GP8 tests clear only unrelated provenance and require only the exact track-name page-policy normalization.
